hypotheses.title: Vortex Circulation Obstacle Bypass Hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Increasing tangential vortex circulation gain will break repulsive equilibrium and guide the robot smoothly past obstacles.
hypotheses.mechanism: Tangential circulation creates a perpendicular vortex force around obstacles, preventing head-on stall.

hypotheses.title: Repulsion Corridor Clearance Hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Decreasing safety margin slightly will reduce premature deceleration and repulsive drag between closely-spaced obstacles.
hypotheses.mechanism: A slightly tighter safety margin allows the robot to enter navigable gaps without excessive repulsive braking.

hypotheses.title: Angular Steering Agility Hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Increasing maximum turn rate will allow the robot to quickly align with tangent escape vectors.
hypotheses.mechanism: Higher angular agility avoids control saturation during rapid heading changes around obstacles.
